snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From GDC 2026
snippet.description:
DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS action roguelite featuring sci-fi dwarves, alien horrors and procedurally-generated caves. Join the elite dwarven Reclaimers and fight through perilous mining facilities infested with deadly Core Spawn. Releasing in early acsess May 20th.

Wishlist DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/2605790/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Rogue_Core/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow
